section: It’s not your fault, Myeongho, and

conversation.speaker: dialogue
conversation.text:
Police: It’s not your fault, Minghao. And it’s not anyone in your family’s fault either.
Respondent: I was the one who told Auntie not to come to the amusement park.
Respondent: I told her that I wanted to go with Xiyuan alone and asked her to stay away from us.
Respondent: That’s why this happened. It’s all my fault. I was the one who told her not to come.
Respondent: Because if we were all at the amusement park,
Respondent: it would look like a family...
Respondent: Mom would see from heaven that Xiyuan calls Auntie “mom.”
Respondent: I don’t believe she is really watching us from heaven. I know she was lying.
Respondent: But...
Respondent: I don’t want mom to be sad.
Respondent: It’s not Auntie’s fault.
Respondent: I was the one who told her not to come.
